newspec-c: record-only → passed (record only (every judged cell passed, the rest is recorded only))
Our own addition (record-only; a write-back would have been a bug). PW, local stack, one physician on two devices. B had the Hospital chart open and had just typed 'Overnight afebrile, HR 76, plan to recheck BMP.' into the pre-round editor; A deleted the patient from its card (native confirm accepted - the native dialog itself is known B24). B, without a reload, replaced the chart with 'Patient not found.' + 'Back to rounds' 91 ms after the delete (name and diagnosis gone, not a blank screen); Save Note was no longer on screen, so it could not be pressed. B's pending autosave did send one rounding:update 84 ms after the delete (rounding.update only patches an existing row and throws 'Patient not found'). Nothing was written back: rounding:get(id) stayed null, no row with the name or B's text appeared, A's list does not show it, also after B reloaded. Recorded for Q6(c) / decision D5: B's session-draft store keeps '<user>:<chartId>:preRoundNotes' = the typed sentence after the delete and after the reload (cleared only at sign-out).

descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S30 Second device after a patient delete: the open chart stops showing the patient, cannot write it back, and leaves no draft

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of that patient's data immediately (removed, not hidden), and the audit log is kept. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-94699 AC 4)
  • T3 No state a delete leads to shows a blank screen, a crash or a raw error: a deleted patient's chart link, the emptied patient list, a patient deleted while its note is generating, and a second device … (TFA-94745 AC 2; UAT Empty & Failure States)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Same account signed in twice (A and B, each with its own email code). B has the Hospital patient's chart open with unsaved pre-round text typed.

When A deletes the patient from its card (OK). B, without reloading, watches the chart, then presses Save Note. Then the runner reads B's IndexedDB.

Then Within the sync window B stops showing the patient's name and diagnosis and shows a clear message or the list, not a blank screen. B's Save Note ends in an explicit error and creates nothing: roundingPatients get(id) stays null and no new chart appears. Draft keys for the deleted chart in B's 'roundcompanion-session-drafts' store are recorded for Q6(c).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92579 AC 2 (all data immediately) and TFA-94745 AC 2 (no blank screen); related to UAT TC-25 'A deletion on one device disappears from the other' (not claimed here). B's checkpoint must not contain the name or the diagnosis; a person checks that the landing is not blank (oracleRules 3). Server read after B's Save Note. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S30 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-24 Deletions · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-24/S30

Detail:

Our own addition (record-only; a write-back would have been a bug). PW, local stack, one physician on two devices. B had the Hospital chart open and had just typed 'Overnight afebrile, HR 76, plan to recheck BMP.' into the pre-round editor; A deleted the patient from its card (native confirm accepted - the native dialog itself is known B24). B, without a reload, replaced the chart with 'Patient not found.' + 'Back to rounds' 91 ms after the delete (name and diagnosis gone, not a blank screen); Save Note was no longer on screen, so it could not be pressed. B's pending autosave did send one rounding:update 84 ms after the delete (rounding.update only patches an existing row and throws 'Patient not found'). Nothing was written back: rounding:get(id) stayed null, no row with the name or B's text appeared, A's list does not show it, also after B reloaded. Recorded for Q6(c) / decision D5: B's session-draft store keeps '<user>:<chartId>:preRoundNotes' = the typed sentence after the delete and after the reload (cleared only at sign-out).

Evidence: 3 attached.
